body_zh: 10月12日上午，调查小组在东岸湿地布设了6条样线，每条样线长500米。观察员共记到水鸟23种，个体总数约1400只。其中苍鹭占比最高，有310只停在浅滩。水体透明度为42厘米，比上月略低。
body_en: On the morning of October 12, a survey team laid out 6 transects in the wetland on the east bank, each 500 meters long. Observers recorded 23 species of waterbirds, about 1400 birds in total. Grey herons made up the largest share, with 310 of them standing in the shallows. Water clarity was 42 centimeters, slightly lower than the month before.

body_zh: 这片混交林位于山谷北坡，面积约有80公顷。林冠上层以栎树和马尾松为主，下层长着成片的杜鹃和蕨类。林间有一条季节性溪流，雨季水深可达半米。落叶在地面堆成厚层，踩上去十分松软。
body_en: This mixed forest lies on the north slope of a valley and covers about 80 hectares. The upper canopy is dominated by oaks and Masson pines, while the lower layer holds dense patches of azaleas and ferns. A seasonal stream runs through the woods, and in the rainy season its water can reach half a meter deep. Fallen leaves lie in a thick layer on the ground and feel very soft underfoot.

body_zh: 研究人员先在样地四角打下木桩，再用绳子围出20米见方的范围。随后他们逐株测量胸径超过5厘米的树木，并在树干上挂好编号牌。测完以后，数据被录入表格，样地位置也标在地图上。
body_en: Researchers first drove wooden stakes into the four corners of the plot, then used rope to mark out a square 20 meters on each side. Next they measured every tree with a trunk diameter over 5 centimeters at breast height, and hung a numbered tag on each trunk. When the measuring was done, the data were entered into a spreadsheet, and the plot location was marked on a map.

body_zh: 去年初夏，一群白鹭飞到河口的芦苇荡里筑巢。巡护员起初只看到十几只，后来巢数逐渐增加到60多个。到了七月，雏鸟陆续离巢，在浅水区学习觅食。秋季来临时，整个鸟群向南迁走了。
body_en: In early summer last year, a flock of egrets flew into the reed beds at the river mouth to build nests. At first the ranger saw only a dozen or so birds, but the number of nests later grew to more than 60. In July the chicks left their nests one after another and learned to forage in the shallow water. When autumn arrived, the whole flock moved away to the south.

body_zh: 湿地中的芦苇能够减缓水流，使泥沙逐渐沉降下来。它们的根茎在淤泥里交错延伸，把岸边的土壤牢牢固定住。茂密的芦苇丛为小鱼和水鸟提供了藏身之处，也能吸收水中多余的养分，因此常被看作湿地健康的标志。
body_en: Reeds in a wetland slow the flow of water, letting sediment gradually settle out. Their rhizomes spread and interlace in the mud, holding the soil along the banks firmly in place. Dense reed beds give small fish and waterbirds places to hide, and they also absorb excess nutrients from the water, so they are often seen as a sign of a healthy wetland.

body_zh: 本季度红外相机共拍到有效照片860张，分布在12个点位。其中野猪出现次数最多，达到214次。小麂被拍到97次，多在清晨活动。另有3个点位首次记录到豹猫，拍摄时间都在夜里。
body_en: This quarter the infrared cameras captured 860 usable photos across 12 sites. Wild boar appeared most often, with 214 detections. Muntjacs were photographed 97 times, mostly active in the early morning. Leopard cats were recorded for the first time at 3 other sites, and all of those photos were taken at night.

body_zh: 高原上的这处湖泊呈狭长形状，南北长约7公里。湖水因含盐较多而带着淡淡的青绿色，岸边的砾石上结着一层白色盐霜。湖东侧是平缓的草甸，地势略高于湖面，每到夏天会开满黄色的小花。
body_en: This lake on the plateau is long and narrow, stretching about 7 kilometers from north to south. Its water has a faint bluish green tint because of its high salt content, and a layer of white salt crust covers the gravel along the shore. On the east side lies a gently sloping meadow, slightly higher than the lake surface, which fills with small yellow flowers every summer.

body_zh: 一片被废弃的农田会逐步恢复成森林。最初几年，地面长满一年生杂草。随后多年生草本和灌木开始占据优势，鸟类带来的种子也在这里发芽。大约二十年后，先锋树种连成小片林地，耐阴的树苗随之在林下生长起来。
body_en: An abandoned farm field gradually turns back into forest. In the first few years, the ground is covered with annual weeds. Then perennial herbs and shrubs begin to dominate, and seeds carried in by birds sprout there as well. After about twenty years, pioneer trees join into small patches of woodland, and saplings that tolerate shade then grow up beneath them.

body_zh: 上个月，一场持续三天的暴雨让山下的小河水位猛涨。洪水退去后，监测人员在下游沙洲上发现了大量冲来的枯枝。有两段河岸出现坍塌，原本长在岸边的柳树倒进了河道。附近一处水獭洞穴也被泥沙填满了。
body_en: Last month, three days of heavy rain made the small river below the mountain rise sharply. After the flood receded, monitoring staff found large numbers of dead branches that had washed up on a sandbar downstream. Two stretches of the bank collapsed, and willows that had grown along the edge fell into the channel. A nearby otter den was also filled with silt.

body_zh: 湿地中的芦苇根系发达，能够固定松软的泥土，减缓水流对岸边的冲刷。芦苇丛还为许多水鸟提供了筑巢和躲避的场所，每年春季，成群的野鸭会在其中产卵。枯萎的芦苇秆沉入水底后慢慢分解，为水中的小型生物提供养分。
body_en: The reeds in a wetland have dense roots, which hold the soft mud in place and slow the erosion of the banks by flowing water. Reed beds also give many water birds places to nest and shelter, and every spring flocks of wild ducks lay their eggs among them. Dead reed stems sink to the bottom and slowly decompose, providing nutrients for small aquatic organisms.
replaced_note: rewritten 11-07 by the coordinator: near-duplicate of another body

body_zh: 3号鸡舍本周存栏蛋鸡4200只，日均产蛋3650枚。周二起饲料换成了新配方，到周四产蛋数开始回升。全周共消耗饲料约3100千克，舍内温度保持在20到23摄氏度之间，湿度变化不大。
body_en: This week Henhouse 3 held 4200 laying hens, which produced an average of 3650 eggs a day. From Tuesday the feed was switched to a new formula, and by Thursday egg numbers had begun to rise again. About 3100 kilograms of feed were used over the week, the indoor temperature stayed between 20 and 23 degrees Celsius, and humidity changed little.

body_zh: 这座牧场坐落在丘陵之间，四周用木栅栏围成几块草场。场部是一排红砖平房，旁边立着两座圆柱形的青贮塔。牛棚朝南敞开，棚顶铺着浅灰色的彩钢板。一条砂石路从大门延伸到挤奶厅门口，路边种着整齐的白杨。
body_en: This ranch sits among low hills, and wooden fences divide the land around it into several pastures. The main office is a row of red brick bungalows, with two cylindrical silage towers standing beside it. The cattle shed opens to the south, and its roof is covered with light grey steel panels. A gravel road runs from the front gate to the door of the milking parlor, lined with neat rows of poplars.

body_zh: 小鸡出壳后，饲养员先把它们转入预热好的育雏室。头三天室温保持在33摄氏度左右，随后每周降低2到3度。饮水中最初加入少量葡萄糖，开食则用细碎的颗粒料。到第六周，鸡群基本脱温，可以转到普通鸡舍饲养。
body_en: After the chicks hatch, keepers first move them into a prewarmed brooding room. For the first three days the room is kept at about 33 degrees Celsius, and the temperature is then lowered by 2 to 3 degrees each week. A little glucose is added to the drinking water at first, and the first feed is finely crumbled pellets. By the sixth week the flock no longer relies on extra heat and can be moved to an ordinary henhouse.

body_zh: 上周三傍晚，牧场东边的围栏被大风刮开了一个缺口。二十多只羊趁机钻出去，散到了附近的苜蓿地里。两名牧工骑着摩托车追了一个多小时，才把羊群赶回圈中。第二天一早，围栏就被换上了新的立柱。
body_en: Last Wednesday evening, strong wind tore a gap in the fence on the east side of the ranch. More than twenty sheep slipped out through it and scattered into a nearby alfalfa field. Two herders chased them on motorcycles for over an hour before driving the flock back into the pen. Early the next morning, the fence was fitted with new posts.

body_zh: 奶牛是反刍动物，胃由四个部分组成。草料先进入瘤胃，在微生物作用下慢慢发酵。休息时，奶牛会把食团送回口中再次咀嚼，这个过程叫作反刍。一头成年奶牛每天花在反刍上的时间通常有七到八个小时。
body_en: Dairy cows are ruminants, and their stomach has four parts. Feed first enters the rumen, where it slowly ferments with the help of microbes. While resting, a cow brings the cud back up into its mouth and chews it again, a process called rumination. An adult dairy cow usually spends seven to eight hours a day ruminating.

body_zh: 本月月底称重时，二号栏的28头育肥猪平均体重为86千克。与上月相比，每头平均增重21千克。这一个月全栏耗用饲料1650千克，饮水量约为每头每天8升。其中有两头体重偏轻，已被调到单独的小栏饲养。
body_en: At the weighing at the end of this month, the 28 finishing pigs in Pen 2 averaged 86 kilograms. Compared with last month, each pig gained 21 kilograms on average. Over the month the pen went through 1650 kilograms of feed, and water intake was about 8 liters per pig per day. Two of the pigs were on the light side and had been moved to a separate small pen.

body_zh: 鸭场建在一片水塘旁边，塘面被竹篱隔成了三个区域。岸上搭着几排矮棚，棚内地面铺有厚厚的稻壳。每天清晨，上千只麻鸭会从棚里涌向水面，塘边的浅滩上满是它们留下的脚印。棚后堆着成袋的玉米和稻谷。
body_en: The duck farm is built beside a pond, and bamboo fencing divides the water into three sections. Several rows of low sheds stand on the bank, their floors covered with a thick layer of rice husks. Every morning, more than a thousand brown ducks pour out of the sheds onto the water, and the shallows by the pond are covered with their footprints. Sacks of corn and rice are piled behind the sheds.

body_zh: 剪羊毛通常在初夏进行。工人先把羊赶进窄道，逐只牵到铺着帆布的台面上。剪毛时从腹部开始，再沿着体侧推向背部，整张羊毛几乎连成一片。剪下的羊毛随后按长度和颜色分拣，打包后送往仓库。
body_en: Sheep shearing usually takes place in early summer. Workers first drive the sheep into a narrow chute and lead them one at a time onto a platform covered with canvas. Shearing starts at the belly and then moves along the flanks toward the back, so the fleece comes off almost in one piece. The shorn wool is then sorted by length and color, baled, and sent to the warehouse.

body_zh: 前天凌晨，一头荷斯坦母牛在产房里产下了一对双胞胎牛犊。值班人员发现时，两头小牛已经能够站立。一头重38千克，另一头重35千克，都比普通牛犊略轻。场里给它们单独准备了一个铺满干草的小隔间。
body_en: Before dawn the day before yesterday, a Holstein cow gave birth to twin calves in the calving barn. By the time the staff on duty found them, both calves could already stand. One weighed 38 kilograms and the other 35, both a little lighter than ordinary calves. The farm set aside a small stall bedded with hay just for them.

body_zh: 鸡没有汗腺，主要依靠张口呼吸来散热。当气温超过30摄氏度时，鸡的采食量会明显下降，产蛋数也随之减少。因此，夏季的鸡舍通常装有风机和湿帘，用水分蒸发带走热量，使室内温度降低几度。
body_en: Chickens have no sweat glands and shed heat mainly by breathing with their beaks open. When the air temperature rises above 30 degrees Celsius, their feed intake drops noticeably, and egg numbers fall with it. For this reason, henhouses in summer are usually fitted with fans and wet cooling pads, which carry heat away through evaporation and lower the indoor temperature by a few degrees.

body_zh: 四月初，社区花园东侧新栽了56株月季，到月底成活了51株。同期播下的波斯菊出苗率约为八成，株高已有15厘米。本月共浇水9次，雨水较多的一周没有浇灌。花坛西角补种了12株薰衣草。
body_en: In early April, 56 rose plants were set out on the east side of the community garden, and 51 had survived by the end of the month. About eight in ten of the cosmos seeds sown at the same time came up, and the seedlings had already reached 15 centimeters in height. The garden was watered 9 times this month, and not at all during one week of heavy rain. Twelve lavender plants were added in the west corner of the flower bed.

body_zh: 这盆五针松盆景已经养了二十多年，主干向左倾斜，弯曲处布满了龟裂的老皮。枝条被修剪成层层叠叠的云片状，针叶短而浓密。花盆是一只浅口的紫砂长方盆，盆面铺着青苔和几块小石头。
body_en: This Japanese white pine bonsai has been tended for more than twenty years. Its trunk leans to the left, and the bends are covered with old, cracked bark. The branches have been pruned into layered, cloudlike pads, and the needles are short and dense. The pot is a shallow rectangular one of purple clay, with moss and a few small stones spread over the soil.

body_zh: 这盆绿萝换盆前，园丁先停了两天水，让盆土变干一些。然后他轻敲盆壁，把植株连同土团一起取出。剪去烂根后，植株被放进大一号的新盆，四周填满新土并压实。浇透水的花盆最后被移到阴凉处缓苗。
body_en: Before this pothos was repotted, the gardener held off watering for two days to let the soil dry a little. Next he tapped the sides of the pot and lifted the plant out together with its root ball. After the rotten roots were cut away, the plant went into a new pot one size larger, and fresh soil was packed in around it. Finally the pot was watered thoroughly and moved to a shady spot so the plant could recover.

body_zh: 前些天的午后，城西植物园突然下起了冰雹，前后持续约十分钟。正在盛开的郁金香被打折了一大片，温室的几块玻璃也出现了裂纹。工作人员连夜清理了落叶和碎枝，第二天又在空出的花床上补种了矮牵牛。
body_en: One afternoon a few days ago, hail suddenly fell on the botanical garden on the west side of the city, lasting about ten minutes in all. A large patch of tulips in full bloom was snapped, and several glass panes in the greenhouse cracked. Staff worked through the night to clear away fallen leaves and broken twigs, and the next day they replanted the empty beds with petunias.

body_zh: 多肉植物的叶片肥厚，能在体内储存大量水分。它们大多原产于干旱地区，耐旱却不耐涝。盆土长期潮湿时，根部很容易腐烂。所以多数养护者会等盆土干透后才浇一次水，冬季浇水的间隔还会更长。
body_en: Succulents have thick, fleshy leaves that can store a great deal of water. Most of them come from dry regions, so they tolerate drought but not waterlogging. When the potting soil stays wet for a long time, their roots rot easily. That is why most growers wait until the soil has dried out completely before watering again, and in winter the gaps between waterings grow even longer.

body_zh: 玻璃温室本周的最高气温出现在周四午后，为31摄氏度。最低气温出现在周一凌晨，只有9摄氏度。白天相对湿度一般在百分之65上下。期间盆栽兰花共开出42朵花，其中蝴蝶兰占了一半以上。
body_en: This week the highest temperature in the glass greenhouse came on Thursday afternoon, at 31 degrees Celsius. The lowest came before dawn on Monday, at only 9 degrees Celsius. Daytime relative humidity was generally around 65 percent. Over the week the potted orchids produced 42 flowers, more than half of them on moth orchids.

body_zh: 这座庭院花园只有四十多平方米，中间铺着一条弯曲的石板小径。小径两旁种着玉簪和绣球，墙角有一棵高过屋檐的桂花树。东墙下摆着一排陶盆，里面是薄荷和迷迭香。院子尽头还有一口小水缸，几片睡莲叶子浮在水面上。
body_en: This courtyard garden covers only a little over forty square meters, with a winding flagstone path running through the middle. Plantain lilies and hydrangeas grow on both sides of the path, and in the corner stands an osmanthus tree taller than the eaves. A row of clay pots lines the foot of the east wall, holding mint and rosemary. At the far end of the yard sits a small water jar, with a few water lily leaves floating on its surface.

body_zh: 番茄种子播下后，大约五天就能破土出苗。最先展开的是两片细长的子叶，之后才长出带锯齿的真叶。苗高约15厘米时，幼苗被移栽到菜园里。再过一个多月，植株陆续开出淡黄色的花，花谢后结出的青果慢慢变红。
body_en: After tomato seeds are sown, seedlings break through the soil in about five days. The first to open are two narrow seed leaves, and only after that do the toothed true leaves appear. When the seedlings reach about 15 centimeters, they are transplanted into the vegetable garden. A little over a month later, the plants gradually open pale yellow flowers, and once the flowers fall, the green fruit that forms slowly turns red.

body_zh: 八月的一个晚上，老街一户人家阳台上的昙花开了。花苞从九点左右开始舒展，到十一点完全打开，直径接近20厘米。邻居们闻到香味，陆续赶来观看。次日清晨，花朵已经合拢并垂了下来。
body_en: One evening in August, an epiphyllum bloomed on the balcony of a home on the old street. The bud began to unfold at about nine and was fully open by eleven, nearly 20 centimeters across. Neighbors caught the scent and came over one after another to look. By early the next morning, the flower had already closed and drooped.

body_zh: 绣球花的颜色会随土壤酸碱度而变化。在酸性土壤中，植株更容易吸收铝离子，花朵多呈蓝色。土壤偏碱时，铝难以被吸收，花色便偏向粉红。有些园艺爱好者会在土里埋入硫磺粉，让花色逐渐转蓝。
body_en: The flower color of hydrangeas changes with soil acidity. In acidic soil the plants take up aluminum more easily, and the flowers are mostly blue. When the soil is alkaline, aluminum is hard to absorb, and the flowers lean toward pink. Some gardeners bury sulfur powder in the soil so that the flowers gradually turn blue.

body_zh: 本周三，5号楼完成了第十二层楼板的混凝土浇筑，共用混凝土186立方米。浇筑从早上七点开始，持续了约九个小时。现场留取试块12组，送往实验室做强度检测。当天午后气温升到29摄氏度，浇好的楼板盖上了保湿薄膜。
body_en: On Wednesday this week, the concrete pour for the twelfth floor slab of Building 5 was completed, using 186 cubic meters of concrete. The pour began at seven in the morning and lasted about nine hours. Twelve sets of test cubes were taken on site and sent to a laboratory for strength testing. The temperature rose to 29 degrees Celsius that afternoon, and the newly poured slab was covered with plastic sheeting to hold in moisture.

body_zh: 这座石拱桥横跨在镇子中央的河上，全长约40米。桥身由青石砌成，中间是一个半圆形的大拱，两侧各有一个小拱用于泄洪。桥面两边立着低矮的石栏，栏板上雕着荷花图案。桥头有几级台阶，表面已被磨得十分光滑。
body_en: This stone arch bridge spans the river in the middle of the town and is about 40 meters long. It is built of bluestone, with a large semicircular arch in the center and a smaller arch on each side to let floodwater through. Low stone railings line both edges of the deck, and lotus patterns are carved into their panels. At the approach to the bridge there are a few steps, worn very smooth.

body_zh: 这栋住宅楼的施工从测量放线开始。随后挖掘机开挖基坑，深度达到6米。基坑底部浇筑垫层后，工人绑扎钢筋并支好模板，接着浇筑承台和地梁。基础完工并回填土方以后，主体结构才逐层向上施工。
body_en: Construction of this apartment building began with surveying and setting out. Excavators then dug the foundation pit to a depth of 6 meters. After a base layer of concrete was poured at the bottom of the pit, workers tied the steel reinforcement and set up the formwork, then poured the pile caps and ground beams. Only after the foundation was finished and the soil backfilled did the main structure begin to go up floor by floor.

body_zh: 昨天上午，一辆运送钢梁的平板车在工地入口陷进了雨后的泥坑。司机试了几次都没能开出来，后面的混凝土罐车也被堵在路上。现场调来一台装载机，用钢丝绳把平板车拖了出来。之后工人在入口铺上了一层碎石。
body_en: Yesterday morning, a flatbed truck carrying steel beams sank into a muddy hole left by the rain at the site entrance. The driver tried several times but could not drive it out, and the concrete mixer trucks behind it were stuck on the road as well. A wheel loader was brought over and pulled the flatbed out with a steel cable. Afterward, workers spread a layer of crushed stone over the entrance.

body_zh: 桥梁的钢结构和混凝土都会随温度热胀冷缩。为了容纳这种变形，桥面每隔一段距离会设置伸缩缝。夏季高温时，缝隙变窄，冬季降温后又会张开。如果没有伸缩缝，桥面就可能被挤得拱起或开裂。
body_en: The steel and concrete of a bridge expand in heat and contract in cold. To accommodate this movement, expansion joints are placed at intervals along the deck. In the summer heat the gaps narrow, and when it cools in winter they open up again. Without expansion joints, the deck could be squeezed until it buckles upward or cracks.

body_zh: 跨河大桥的静载试验于10月20日进行，共使用了16辆装满砂石的卡车，每辆总重约35吨。卡车分四批驶上桥面，停放在指定位置。测得主跨中点的最大下挠为28毫米，卸载后桥面基本恢复原位。
body_en: A static load test of the river bridge was carried out on October 20 with 16 trucks loaded with sand and gravel, each weighing about 35 tonnes in total. The trucks drove onto the deck in four groups and parked at marked positions. The largest downward deflection, measured at the midpoint of the main span, was 28 millimeters, and the deck returned almost to its original position once the load was removed.

body_zh: 工地中央立着一台塔式起重机，高约60米，塔身由方形钢架拼接而成。顶部向一侧伸出长长的起重臂，另一侧的平衡臂上挂着几块混凝土配重。司机室位于塔顶下方，四面都装有玻璃。起重臂末端在夜里会亮起一盏红色警示灯。
body_en: A tower crane stands in the middle of the site, about 60 meters tall, its mast built from square steel frame sections. At the top a long jib reaches out to one side, and several concrete counterweights hang from the shorter arm on the other side. The operator cab sits just below the top, with glass on all four sides. At night a red warning light glows at the tip of the jib.

body_zh: 建造这座斜拉桥时，施工队首先在河中打下钻孔桩，筑起两座主塔的基础。主塔随后逐段升高到120米。接着，钢箱梁从塔身两侧对称地悬臂拼装，每装一段就挂上一对斜拉索。两侧梁段在河中央合龙后，桥面铺装随即展开。
body_en: To build this bridge, whose deck hangs from stay cables, the crew first drilled bored piles into the riverbed and built the foundations of the two main towers. The towers then rose section by section to 120 meters. Next, steel box girders were assembled outward from both sides of each tower in balanced pairs, and a pair of stay cables was hung after each new segment. Once the girders from the two sides met in the middle of the river, paving of the deck began right away.

body_zh: 上月末，城东那座使用了三十年的人行天桥被拆除了。凌晨一点，桥下道路被临时封闭。工人把桥身切成四段，两台大型吊车依次把它们吊上运输车。整个过程不到六个小时，早高峰之前道路就恢复了通行。
body_en: At the end of last month, the pedestrian overpass on the east side of the city, in use for thirty years, was taken down. At one in the morning the road beneath it was temporarily closed. Workers cut the span into four sections, and two large cranes lifted them one by one onto transport trucks. The whole job took less than six hours, and the road reopened before the morning rush hour.

body_zh: 混凝土的抗压能力很强，抗拉能力却只有抗压的十分之一左右。钢筋恰好擅长承受拉力，而且两者受热后的膨胀程度十分接近。工程上一般把钢筋布置在梁和楼板的受拉一侧，这样构件在承受荷载时，就不容易开裂。
body_en: Concrete is very strong in compression, but its tensile strength is only about one tenth of its compressive strength. Steel bars are good at carrying tension, and the two materials expand by very similar amounts when heated. In practice, steel bars are usually placed on the tension side of beams and floor slabs, so that the members are less likely to crack under load.

body_zh: 二号注塑车间昨天三个班次共生产瓶盖12万只。质检员从中抽检了500只，发现5只边缘带有毛刺。全天设备累计停机40分钟，主要原因是一台注塑机的加热圈损坏。更换零件后，生产在下午两点恢复正常。
body_en: Yesterday, Injection Molding Workshop 2 produced 120 thousand bottle caps over three shifts. An inspector sampled 500 of them and found burrs on the edges of 5. Equipment downtime for the day added up to 40 minutes, mainly because a heater band on one molding machine failed. After the part was replaced, production returned to normal at two in the afternoon.

body_zh: 这间装配车间长约120米，屋顶开着一排采光天窗。车间正中是一条缓缓移动的传送带，左右两边排着二十多个工位。工位上方挂着工具架和照明灯，地面用黄线划出了通道。车间一角堆放着待组装的零件箱，叉车在箱子间来回穿行。
body_en: This assembly workshop is about 120 meters long, with a row of skylights along the roof. A slowly moving conveyor belt runs down the middle, with more than twenty workstations lined up along its two sides. Tool racks and work lights hang above the workstations, and yellow lines on the floor mark out the walkways. Boxes of parts waiting to be assembled are stacked in one corner, and forklifts weave back and forth between them.

body_zh: 玻璃瓶的生产从配料开始，石英砂和纯碱按比例混合后送入熔炉。原料在约1500摄氏度的高温下熔成玻璃液，随后被剪成大小一致的料滴。料滴落入模具，经吹气成型为瓶子。瓶子在退火炉中缓慢降温，检验合格后装箱入库。
body_en: Glass bottle production begins with batching, in which quartz sand and soda ash are mixed in set proportions and fed into a furnace. The raw materials melt into molten glass at a high temperature of about 1500 degrees Celsius and are then cut into gobs of equal size. Each gob drops into a mold and is blown into the shape of a bottle. The bottles cool slowly in an annealing oven, and those that pass inspection are boxed and stored.

body_zh: 上周五夜班，包装线末端的封箱机突然卡住，输送线上的纸箱很快堆成了一排。班长按下停机按钮，和维修工一起拆开护罩检查。原来是一卷胶带的纸芯脱落，缠进了滚轮。清理完毕后，停了约二十分钟的生产线重新运转起来。
body_en: During the night shift last Friday, the case sealer at the end of the packaging line suddenly jammed, and cartons on the conveyor quickly backed up in a row. The shift leader pressed the stop button and opened the guard with a maintenance worker to check. It turned out that the paper core of a tape roll had come loose and wound into the rollers. Once it was cleared, the line, which had been stopped for about twenty minutes, started running again.

body_zh: 在许多工厂里，首件检验是指每批产品开工时，先对第一件成品做全面检测。只有首件的尺寸和外观都合格，这一批才会正式投产。这样做能及早发现设备调整或材料上的问题，避免整批产品出现同样的缺陷。
body_en: In many factories, first article inspection means that when production of each batch begins, the first finished piece is checked in full. Only if its dimensions and appearance both pass does the batch go into full production. This catches problems with machine setup or materials early, and keeps the whole batch from ending up with the same defect.

body_zh: 整个十月，质检部门共抽检电机外壳3200件，不合格品41件。尺寸超差的有23件，表面划伤的有15件，另有3件存在气孔。比起九月，不合格率下降了约三分之一。不合格品已全部返回机加工工段处理。
body_en: Throughout October, the quality department sampled 3200 motor housings and found 41 defective pieces. Of these, 23 were out of dimensional tolerance, 15 had surface scratches, and 3 contained gas pores. Compared with September, the defect rate fell by about one third. All the defective pieces were sent back to the machining section to be dealt with.

body_zh: 这台焊接机器人固定在生产线旁的底座上，机械臂有六个关节，末端装着一支焊枪。工作区被一圈橙色的防护栏围住，四周挂着深色的遮光帘。旁边的控制柜上有一块显示屏，屏幕下方是一个红色的急停按钮。
body_en: This welding robot is mounted on a base beside the production line. Its arm has six joints, and a welding torch is fitted at the end. The work area is enclosed by an orange safety fence, with dark shading curtains hanging all around. A control cabinet beside it has a display screen, and below the screen is a red emergency stop button.

body_zh: 在纺纱车间，原棉先经过开松和清理，去掉其中的杂质和短绒。随后梳棉机把纤维梳理成薄薄的棉网，再收拢成一根粗棉条。棉条经过并条和粗纱工序被逐渐拉细，最后在细纱机上加捻成纱，绕到纱管上。
body_en: In the spinning workshop, raw cotton is first opened and cleaned to remove impurities and short fibers. A carding machine then combs the fibers into a thin web and gathers it into a thick sliver. The sliver is drawn out gradually through the drawing and roving stages, and is finally twisted into yarn on a spinning frame and wound onto bobbins.

body_zh: 今年夏天，一家食品厂的饼干生产线完成了改造。旧的燃气隧道炉被换成电热炉，换装期间生产线停了整整两周。新炉投用后，饼干的颜色更加均匀，每小时产量从800千克提高到950千克。车间里的温度也比以前低了不少。
body_en: This summer, the biscuit production line at a food factory was refitted. The old gas tunnel oven was replaced with an electric one, and the line was shut down for two full weeks during the changeover. Once the new oven came into use, the biscuits browned more evenly, and hourly output rose from 800 to 950 kilograms. The workshop was also noticeably cooler than before.

body_zh: 精密零件通常放在恒温室里检测尺寸，室温常年恒定在20摄氏度。这是因为金属受热会膨胀，一根100毫米长的钢件，温度每升高1摄氏度，长度大约增加1微米。对于公差只有几微米的零件，这样的变化足以改变检测结论。
body_en: Precision parts usually have their dimensions measured in a constant temperature room kept at 20 degrees Celsius all year round. This is because metal expands when heated. A steel piece 100 millimeters long grows by about 1 micrometer for every 1 degree Celsius rise in temperature. For parts with tolerances of only a few micrometers, such a change is enough to alter the inspection result.
